name: learnthings
description: Sync your learnthings flashcard decks, search them, and add notes.
long_description: Signs in to learnthings and keeps a local copy of your decks, replicated from the server. Sync is a single pass that leaves nothing running in the background; run it again to push later work back up and pick up changes made elsewhere.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in with an email address and password.

tools.name: login_with_google
tools.description: Sign in with a Google account via the browser.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show who is signed in and which backend is in use.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Sign out and clear the saved session.

tools.name: sync_decks
tools.description: Reconcile decks between the server and the local copy, then load them.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: List locally synced decks with note, card and note-type counts.

tools.name: describe_deck
tools.description: Show a deck's note types, their fields and what each field holds.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Add a note to a note type, filling its text fields.

tools.name: add_field
tools.description: Add a text field to a note type.

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Remove a field from a note type, deleting its content from every note.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Find notes whose text contains a phrase.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Show every field of one note.

couch_host.title: Backend URL
couch_host.description: The learnthings proxy in front of CouchDB. Use http://localhost:3000 for the local stack.

use_auth_emulator.title: Use the local Firebase auth emulator
use_auth_emulator.description: Only for the local development stack. Real Google sign-in needs this off, and a backend running against real Firebase.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: An OAuth client of type 'Desktop app'. Needed only for Google sign-in against the real backend.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: Issued alongside the client ID above.

data_dir.title: Local deck storage
data_dir.description: Where local copies of your decks are kept. Leave blank to use ~/.learnthings-mcp/data.
